stories.title: Fatal Northeast Fresno crash renews debate over safety at Friant and Shepherd intersection
stories.summary: A deadly crash at one of Fresno's most notorious intersections is renewing debate over how the city should improve traffic safety, with Fresno County Supervisor Garry Bredefeld calling for millions of dollars in new enforcement efforts.

stories.summary: ICE agents were seen smashing a car window and detaining a man outside a Santa Clarita, California Sheriff's Station.

stories.title: Watching Your Wallet: How to avoid postponing retirement
stories.summary: According to a survey from F&G Annuities and Life, pre-retirees cite economic volatility as driving their concerns.

stories.title: Drought reveals remnants of communities beneath Jordan Lake in North Carolina
